docs.title: code_to_graph Developer Documentation
docs.text:
Welcome to the official developer portal for code_to_graph.

This system converts Python codebases into a graph representation, enriches graph entities with GPT, traces runtime workflow, and outputs production-grade documentation assets.

docs.title: Implemented Capabilities
docs.text:
• Per-function deep descriptions included in report + assets.
  • Function route metadata in project/module/submodule format.
  • Business/domain tagging surfaced per function.
  • Function/workflow test scenarios with sample inputs/outputs + negative/error trace hints.
  • Docs auto-generation on git push via GitHub Actions.
  • Debugging agent for error descriptions or pasted stack traces.
  • Guarded auto-fix workflow with dry-run/apply + validation + rollback reporting.

docs.title: What You Get
docs.text:
• Structural Graph

    outputs/raw_graph.json Base graph generated before GPT enrichment.

  • Enriched Graph

    outputs/enriched_graph.json Node-level semantic enrichment with fallback behavior.

  • Final Report

    outputs/code_documentation.pdf Full code documentation report (function reference, workflow, dependency map, test scenarios).

  • Function Description Asset

    outputs/assets/function_descriptions.json Function-level descriptions, route, tags, workflow participation metadata.

  • Testing Scenario Asset

    outputs/test_scenarios.json Function/workflow sample test scenarios with expected outputs and failure hints.

  • Debug + Auto-Fix Reports

    outputs/debug_fix_report.json, outputs/autofix_report.json Root-cause and fix proposal artifacts from debugging/auto-fix agents.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
Standard modeBevel mode 
pip install -r requirements.txt
python main.py --folder ../book_synthesiser

pip install -r requirements.txt
python main.py --folder ../book_synthesiser --bevel-graph ../bevel-export.json

docs.title: Delivery Checklist
docs.text:
• Generate full function descriptions + route metadata
  • Generate business/domain tags
  • Generate function/workflow test scenarios
  • Enable docs-on-push automation
  • Add debugging agent for text/trace inputs
  • Add guarded auto-fix workflow

docs.title: Docs Auto-Generation on Git Push
docs.text:
Workflow file: .github/workflows/docs-on-push.yml

The workflow triggers on every push (**) and performs:

  1. dependency installation
  2. documentation pipeline run (python main.py --folder .)
  3. debug agent smoke test
  4. auto-fix agent smoke test (dry-run)
  5. MkDocs strict build
  6. artifact upload
  7. GitHub Pages publish for main/master

docs.title: Required Secret
docs.text:
• OPENAI_API_KEY (recommended for richer enrichment/fix suggestions)

Without this secret, fallback logic still runs and pipeline remains operational.

docs.title: Guarded Auto-Fix Flow
docs.text:
Use autofix_agent.py for a controlled patch cycle:

  1. ingest error text/trace
  2. propose minimal file edits
  3. optionally apply edits (--apply)
  4. run validation command
  5. rollback automatically if validation fails

Dry-run (proposal only):

python autofix_agent.py --error-file ./error_trace.txt --project-folder .

Apply mode (guarded):

python autofix_agent.py --error-file ./error_trace.txt --project-folder . --apply --validation-command "python -m pytest -q"

docs.title: Bevel Integration
docs.text:
You can ingest a Bevel-exported graph JSON and still apply local AST overlay + documentation generation.

python main.py --folder ../book_synthesiser --bevel-graph ./bevel_export.json

This mode preserves graph source while augmenting function metadata and report outputs.

docs.title: Bevel Integration
docs.text:
This project supports integration with Bevel-Software/code-to-knowledge-graph.

Why this mode exists

It allows you to use Bevel graph extraction while keeping your downstream enrichment and reporting pipeline intact.

docs.title: How It Works
docs.text:
1. Export graph JSON from Bevel.
  2. Pass that JSON via --bevel-graph.
  3. Adapter maps Bevel schema into internal graph model.
  4. Pipeline continues with enrichment, workflow tracing, and report generation.

docs.title: Command
docs.text: python main.py --folder ../book_synthesiser --bevel-graph ../bevel-export.json

docs.title: Adapter Behavior
docs.text:
functions/bevel_adapter.py handles:

  • schema normalization (nodes, edges/connections)
  • relation coercion (calls, imports, defines, inherits_from)
  • symbol-noise filtering

docs.title: AST Overlay in Bevel Mode
docs.text:
pipeline.py overlays AST metadata after Bevel ingest to improve function quality:

  • argument lists
  • return annotations
  • docstrings
  • call edges from parsed code

This is why Bevel mode still produces high-quality function and workflow sections.

docs.title: Data Flow
docs.text:
flowchart TD
  A[Bevel export JSON] --> B[bevel_adapter.py]
  B --> C[Internal graph]
  C --> D[AST metadata overlay]
  D --> E[GPT enrichment]
  E --> F[Workflow trace]
  F --> G[PDF report]

docs.title: Architecture Overview
docs.text:
Core execution flow:

  1. CLI entry (main.py)
  2. Pipeline orchestration (pipeline.py)
  3. Graph generation (standard mode) or graph ingestion (Bevel mode)
  4. GPT enrichment (lang_q/query_engine.py)
  5. Workflow tracing (functions/workflow_builder.py)
  6. Function metadata + test scenario generation
  7. PDF generation (functions/pdf_generator.py)
flowchart LR
  A[main.py] --> B[pipeline.py]
  B --> C[Parse or Ingest Graph]
  C --> D[GPT Enrichment]
  D --> E[Workflow Trace]
  E --> F[PDF + JSON Assets]

docs.title: Capability Mapping
docs.text:
• Every function description in assets/report Implemented via functions/function_descriptions_asset.py and rendered in Chapter 2.
  • Function route (project/module/submodule) Included as route in function asset and PDF function reference.
  • Business/domain tags Implemented by functions/metadata_builder.py.
  • Function/workflow test scenarios with sample I/O Implemented by functions/test_scenarios.py, rendered in Chapter 5.
  • Debugging agent for description/trace input debug_agent.py + functions/debugging_agent.py.
  • Error-to-fix automatic flow autofix_agent.py + functions/autofix_agent.py (guarded mode).
  • Docs on git push .github/workflows/docs-on-push.yml.

docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
Standard mode:

python main.py --folder ../book_synthesiser

Bevel mode:

python main.py --folder ../book_synthesiser --bevel-graph ../bevel-export.json

Debugging agent (error text):

python debug_agent.py --error-text "ValueError: invalid payload shape"

Debugging agent (trace file):

python debug_agent.py --error-file ./sample_trace.txt

Safe auto-fix (dry-run):

python autofix_agent.py --error-file ./sample_trace.txt --project-folder .

docs.title: Pipeline Stages
docs.text:
1. Scan files: discover Python source files in target folder.
  2. Build graph: create node/edge model from code structure.
  3. Enrich nodes: add LLM summaries and metadata.
  4. Trace workflow: identify entry points and execution flow.
  5. Generate outputs: PDF, function asset JSON, and test scenarios.

Outputs are written to outputs/.

docs.title: Pipeline Stages
docs.text:
pipeline.py runs five explicit stages and prints progress logs.

Execution model

The pipeline is intentionally linear and stage-logged so issues are easy to isolate.

docs.title: Stage 1
docs.text:
• Standard mode: scan files, parse AST, resolve entities, build graph.
  • Bevel mode: load graph from Bevel export JSON.

docs.title: Stage 2
docs.text:
• Standard mode: completed as part of graph build flow.
  • Bevel mode: scan/parse source code and overlay AST metadata onto Bevel nodes.

This overlay improves:

  • function arguments
  • return annotations
  • docstrings
  • same-file call links

docs.title: Stage 3 - Enrichment
docs.text:
lang_q/query_engine.py enriches node metadata with GPT.

  • purpose
  • inputs
  • outputs
  • summary sentence

All GPT calls are protected by try/except, and fallback text is used on failure.

Resilience rule

A single GPT failure must not terminate the whole run.

docs.title: Stage 4 - Workflow Trace
docs.text:
functions/workflow_builder.py builds workflow steps from call edges:

  • identifies likely entry points
  • removes duplicate/redundant steps
  • outputs ordered narrative-friendly sequence

After tracing, metadata and QA artifacts are generated:

  • functions/metadata_builder.py adds route path + business tags + logic detail per function
  • functions/test_scenarios.py builds function/workflow sample test scenarios
  • output is saved to outputs/test_scenarios.json

docs.title: Stage 5 - PDF Generation
docs.text:
functions/pdf_generator.py generates a professional report with:

  • Chapter 1: structure overview
  • Chapter 2: function reference
  • Chapter 3: execution workflow
  • Chapter 4: dependency map + architecture snapshot
  • Chapter 5: generated testing scenarios
  • Chapter 6: summary

docs.title: Stage Summary Table
docs.text: Stage Main Owner Output 1 scanner/parser/adapter base graph in memory 2 AST overlay (Bevel mode) richer function metadata 3 query engine enriched graph 4 workflow + metadata + scenarios ordered workflow + test_scenarios.json 5 pdf generator final report

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
First check

Confirm command path and mode (standard vs --bevel-graph) before deeper debugging.

docs.title: Missing OpenAI Key
docs.text:
• Symptom: enrichment/fix quality drops to fallback heuristics.
  • Fix: set OPENAI_API_KEY in environment or .env.

docs.title: Invalid Folder Path
docs.text:
• Symptom: ValueError: Invalid folder path.
  • Fix: verify --folder points to a real Python project directory.

docs.title: No Python Files Found
docs.text:
• Symptom: RuntimeError: No Python files found under ....
  • Fix: ensure the target contains .py files and pass the correct root folder.

docs.title: Bevel Graph Format Error
docs.text:
• Symptom: adapter schema/format parsing error.
  • Fix: re-export valid Bevel JSON and pass correct --bevel-graph file path.

docs.title: Debug Agent Input Issues
docs.text:
• Provide exactly one source: --error-text or --error-file.
  • For large traces, include failing frame + final exception line.

docs.title: Auto-Fix Apply Rollback
docs.text:
• Symptom: edits applied and then reverted.
  • Cause: validation command returned non-zero exit code.
  • Fix: inspect outputs/autofix_report.json, adjust patch/validation command, rerun.

docs.title: MkDocs Build or Publish Issues
docs.text:
• Ensure all files in mkdocs.yml nav exist under docs/.
  • Run mkdocs build --strict locally before push.
  • Ensure GitHub Pages is enabled for the repository branch/pages setup.

docs.title: Quick Diagnostics
docs.text:
python main.py --folder ../book_synthesiser
python debug_agent.py --error-text "ValueError: invalid payload shape"
python autofix_agent.py --error-text "ValueError: invalid payload shape in run_pipeline"
mkdocs build --strict
